subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Should this PR be selected as the canonical fix for the linked empty-error-retry bug over the other open candidate PRs?
rationale: The code path is correct enough to keep open, but multiple open PRs implement overlapping retry-state semantics and the selected patch will define provider-error retry ordering before failover.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Accept this focused per-attempt metadata approach, land it after ordinary branch/check refresh, and close the duplicate candidate PRs as superseded.

options.title: Prefer the broader state-owner PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97899 if maintainers want the current-attempt state tracked through the subscription/tool state owner despite its current conflict surface.

options.title: Pause for a replacement
options.body: Ask for one maintainer-owned replacement if neither open branch matches the desired permanent retry-state boundary.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Accept this focused per-attempt metadata approach, land it after ordinary branch/check refresh, and close the duplicate candidate PRs as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame points the current embedded-runner retry and attempt assembly surfaces through Vincent Koc's commits, and this choice affects current runtime behavior.
